queries: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget), event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), above_average AS (SELECT e.link_to_event, e.avg_amount, e.avg_amount - o.avg_amount AS above_overall_by FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.avg_amount > o.avg_amount) SELECT link_to_event, avg_amount, above_overall_by, avg_amount - AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS gap_from_above_average_mean FROM above_average ORDER BY gap_from_above_average_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget), above_average AS (SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.average_amount, ea.average_amount - o.average_amount AS above_overall FROM event_averages ea CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ea.average_amount > o.average_amount) SELECT link_to_event, average_amount, above_overall, average_amount - (SELECT AVG(average_amount) FROM above_average) AS gap_from_above_average_mean FROM above_average ORDER BY gap_from_above_average_mean DESC, link_to_event LIMIT 10;
